residuals: Determinism: plugin catalog kinds, target kinds, check kinds and presets inside set/frozenset-typed fields are not walked (contributions.py _Walker.walk, names(), hashing.time_needs only walk list/tuple), so version bumps do not change node hashes or Plan.requires
Validator: a pinning macro bound to a local name (tap = s.probe.pinned_tap; p = s.probe) and called per row inside @eks.dynamic in a take escapes pin.loop

Determinism: builtins allowlist for @eks.dynamic and @sc.bpy code still has a variant that escapes capture_function / dynamic.binding (re-probe aliases, getattr chains, nested code objects, comprehension scopes)
Determinism: render length and cut are missing from render node hashes (score/edit window, embedding length)
Determinism and validation: times inside JSON-valued fields are invisible (gfx assign SetProp.value, Blender set/assign values)
Determinism: the seed snapshot key ignores resource kind versions
Determinism: analysis chosen per machine is treated as pure and immutable in cache keys (BeatTracker backend auto, STTMarkers, the text media check)
Determinism and requirements: plugin default checks are not pinned by plans
Validation: a node may drive another session's lease or backend (hand-written and MCP plans); session identity not enforced (session.mismatch, session.uses bypass)
Incorrect behaviour: relative media paths of embedded scenes resolve against the embedding plan's base
Determinism and tracing: clock providers (tempo source, marker and word streams) are not graph dependencies
Determinism and validation: marker streams and word sources named by plain strings share one unchecked plan-wide namespace
Determinism: cache_inputs ignores the needs of cues
Determinism: artifact: URIs are treated as immutable but the store mutates them
Determinism: render choices made per machine (GPU, encoder, Blender device) are cacheable by node hash alone
Determinism: fonts referenced by family name never enter hashes or cache keys
Determinism: code from plugins outside the tree makes plans machine dependent
Requires and hashes: renderer and backend plugins are not recorded
Validation: Node.out is trusted
Validation: after edges are checked neither against refs nor against visibility
Validation: expect.eventually over mutating or snapshot producers
Seeds: an extending seed can redeclare its base's resources and personas
Validation: evidence.duplicate misses literal names inside runtime eks.each
Determinism: nodes that use several resources join only one lane in eks.parallel
Determinism and correctness: the process-global registry leaks between trees in long-running hosts
Determinism: ML inference nodes are cacheable by node hash alone
Validation: seed resource paths, keys and personas are trusted from plan JSON
Validation: scene graph invariants are enforced only by the builders, not the validator
Determinism: Blender cache keys (machine_dependent, BlenderRender fields)
Validation: tempo presence is trusted (validator has_tempo/external)
